input_file.description: Path to the input .osm, .pbf, .o5m, or compressed file.

output_dir.description: Directory where output .osm.pbf files will be written.

map_id.description: Base map ID for output files (e.g., 63240001.osm.pbf).

description.description: Description string written into the generated template.args file.

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of nodes allowed in any single output tile.

max_areas.description: Maximum number of areas processed in a single pass over the source file.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of threads used by mkgmap-splitter.

resolution.description: Resolution of the density map grid (1-24). Higher values require more memory.

num_tiles.description: Target number of tiles to produce. If set, --max-nodes is ignored.

keep_complete.description: Use additional phases to avoid broken ways and polygons across tile borders.

wanted_admin_level.description: Lowest admin_level value of boundary relations to keep complete.

split_file.description: Path to a previous areas.list or .kml file to reuse calculated tile areas.

problem_file.description: Path to a file containing ways/relations known to cause split problems.

geonames_file.description: Path to a GeoNames cities15000.zip file for determining tile names.

search_limit.description: Search limit in split algorithm. Higher values find better splits but take longer.

status_freq.description: Interval in seconds to display JVM memory usage. Set to 0 to disable.

stop_after.description: Debugging option to stop after a phase: split, gen-problem-list, handle-problem-list, or dist.

output_format.description: Output file format: xml, pbf, o5m, or simulate.

boundary_tags.description: Comma separated list of tag values for relations to filter for problem-list processing.

precomp_sea.description: Path to a directory containing precompiled sea tiles.

write_kml.description: Path to write a KML file containing the calculated areas.

problem_report.description: Path to write the generated problem list created with --keep-complete.

mixed.description: Specify if input OSM file has nodes, ways, and relations intermingled.

no_trim.description: Do not trim empty space off the edges of tiles.

polygon_file.description: Path to a bounding polygon file in osmosis polygon format.

polygon_desc_file.description: Path to an OSM file with named ways describing bounding polygons.
